ticks.note: Tick 1 enters the initial state, `Off`. Its transition is delayed, so it cannot fire in the tick `Off` was entered, whatever `button` is.
`button` is true, so the transition from `Off` to `On` fires and sets `light` to true.
`button` is false, so nothing fires. The chart stays in `On` and `light` keeps its value, true.
`button` is still false (an input keeps its value until you change it), so nothing fires.
`button` is true, so the transition from `On` to `Off` fires and sets `light` to false.
`button` is false, so nothing fires. The chart stays in `Off` and `light` keeps its value, false.
`button` is true again: `Off` to `On` fires and `light` is true.
